value.rationale: The central sampled Mellin multiplicativity defect was a named new operator family and ideal-refinement question. S1 and exact trace had already been shown for the square, but neither implies a quasi-Schatten threshold below one. The sharp two-sided quadratic singular-number classification is a natural nontrivial quantitative invariant of this canonical operator, with a precise weak endpoint and independent dyadic and inverse proofs.
